title: Already Crafted
description: Some crafting recipes that make sense
body:
this **Datapack** is made to make recipies that just make sense like an **enchanted golden apple** recipie

<details>
<summary>Recipies</summary>

1. _Enchanted golden apple_ (9 _gold blocks_ and and an _apple_)
2. _Breeze Rod_
3. **Unoxidizing** and **Unwaxing** _copper_ in a **stonecutter**
4. some _dyes_
5. _glowstone dust_
6. _glow ink sac_
7. _leather_
8. _magma_
9. recycling _tools_ in a **stonecutter**(_only wooden tools for now i will implement this one later_)
10. some _stones_
11. _sand_
12. _gravel_
13. striping _wood_ with a **stonecutter**
14. converting _amethyst buds, clusters and blocks_ into _shards_ with a **stonecutter**
15. converting _honeycomb block_ into _honeycombs_ with a **stonecutter**
16. putting _two slabs_ in the crafting grid to make a _block_
17. putting a _stick_ or _bamboo_ on a **campfire** makes _torches_
   and more

</details>
